description: RAI-242 cancel-mid-run corpus extension goldens (llm4s consumer only): mid-response cancellation and the late-cancel distinction. Validated by the standalone driver contracts/acceptance/cross-ecosystem/llm4s-consumer/run-cancel-mid-response.sh against a slowly-streaming stand (--delay-ms). Kept separate from expected/golden-checks.json because the run-all checker requires every golden to match exactly one manifest entry; wiring into run-all is deferred to RAI-238 (not purely additive: it would require lib.sh run_checker manifest-list edits). Existing frozen expectations are unchanged.
